nary_nodes.label: DR Congo Ebola outbreak
evidence: The country has been grappling with its 17th Ebola outbreak since 15 May.
Three months since the outbreak was declared, infections and deaths continue to rise.
It has been caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of the virus, which had not been seen for more than a decade.
Official figures show that there have been 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths - the second deadliest Ebola outbreak.
